stories.start_quote: והצדיק הזה הי' נחבא אל הכלים
stories.summary_en: R. Avraham Abele, the author of a kabbalistic commentary on the Tikkunim, lived hidden as a children's teacher and was recognised only by the rabbi of Drohobych; when his book came before R. Zvi of Zhidachov, R. Zvi marvelled at the author's spiritual attainment and praised it at length to his disciples.

quotes: הי' נחבא אל הכלים מיקרי דרדקי ולא הכירו אדם
tags.why: the author lived as a concealed tzaddik working as a melamed
the hidden author's greatness is disclosed to others through his book
the book is a Lurianic kabbalistic commentary

quotes: וכבר בימי חורפי היה זה הספר לפני עיני
tags.why: a hidden kabbalistic manuscript is passed on and shown
the narrator recalls his master and uncle R. Zvi teaching his disciples

quotes: מורי ורבי מובהק דודי איש אלקים קדוש
tags.why: the narrator's uncle and the author's great-grandson both appear

quotes: הי' מתמיה ומפליא הרבה על השגת המחבר הזה
tags.why: the author's unknown greatness is recognised through his book
